title: AWCS McLeod Order Integration Monitoring Dashboard
description: Tracks API calls, performance metrics, and order processing flows between AWCS and McLeod services in SIT environment with real-time monitoring, alerts, and trace-based debugging capabilities

panels.title: Executive Summary
panels.description: 24h KPI snapshot for AWCS ↔ McLeod API traffic in SIT.

panels.title: Total API Calls
panels.description: Total count of all outgoing HTTP requests from AWCS McLeod services in the last 24 hours

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint"[$__interval]))

panels.title: Avg API Response Time
panels.description: Average duration of all API calls to external endpoints (excluding health checks)

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | unwrap tsNs [$__interval])) / 1000000

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of successful API calls (HTTP 200-299 status codes). ASSUMPTION: response status is read from an "Outgoing HTTP Response <-" log line with a status=NNN token — adjust the regex if the actual response log format differs.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Response <-" ${include_actuator} | regexp `status[=:]\s*(?P<status_code>[0-9]{3})` | status_code=~"2.."[$__interval])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Response <-" ${include_actuator} [$__interval])) * 100

panels.title: Active Service Integrations
panels.description: Count of unique services actively calling external endpoints in real-time

targets.expr: count(count by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint"[$__interval])))

panels.title: API Endpoints Detail
panels.description: Detailed breakdown of all API calls by endpoint, service, and performance metrics. Click a Trace ID to open the trace in Tempo.

panels.title: API Endpoints Activity Summary
panels.description: Detailed breakdown of all API calls by endpoint, service, and performance metrics. Click trace ID for distributed trace analysis.

panels.title: Performance Metrics
panels.description: Response-time distribution and endpoint call volume across the selected time range.

panels.title: API Response Time Distribution
panels.description: Histogram showing distribution of API call durations across all endpoints, bucketed in 100ms increments.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 0 | tsNs <= 100000000 [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 100000000 | tsNs <= 200000000 [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 200000000 | tsNs <= 300000000 [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 300000000 | tsNs <= 400000000 [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 400000000 | tsNs <= 500000000 [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 500000000 | tsNs <= 600000000 [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 600000000 [$__range]))

panels.title: Calls by Endpoint
panels.description: Top 10 most called API endpoints ranked by call count.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (api_endpoint) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint"[$__range])))

panels.title: Tempo Traces Detail
panels.description: Complete trace information from Tempo including endpoints, durations, and service dependencies.

panels.title: API Traces with Endpoint Details
panels.description: Complete trace information from Tempo including endpoints, durations, and service dependencies.

panels.title: Service Correlation Analysis
panels.description: Which services call which external endpoints, how often, and the typical order-processing sequence.

panels.title: Service Call Dependencies
panels.description: Showing which services call which external endpoints and frequency (epe-awcs-mcleod-intg-ms, epe-awcs-mcleod-order-update-intg-ms -> tms-ctsm.mcleodhosted.com, login.microsoftonline.com, sbt-*). Edge thickness is proportional to call frequency; color reflects success rate.

panels.title: Order Processing Flow Timeline
panels.description: Timeline showing the typical sequence of API calls for a single order (trace-based): Movement Search -> Movement Update -> Response. Color = service; bar length = time between steps.

panels.title: Error & Anomaly Detection
panels.description: Failure rates by service and calls that breach the 500ms latency budget.

panels.title: Error Rate by Service
panels.description: Percentage of failed calls per service in the last 24 hours. ASSUMPTION: same response-log status convention as the Success Rate panel — adjust if needed.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Response <-" ${include_actuator} | regexp `status[=:]\s*(?P<status_code>[0-9]{3})` | status_code=~"[45].." [$__interval])) / sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Response <-" ${include_actuator} [$__interval])) * 100

panels.title: Slow API Calls (>500ms)
panels.description: Count of API calls exceeding the 500ms threshold in the last hour.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" ${include_actuator} | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)` | http_method=~"$http_method" | api_endpoint=~"$api_endpoint" | tsNs > 500000000 [1h]))

panels.title: Raw Logs Explorer
panels.description: Complete logs from all API calls including payloads (truncated for readability).

panels.title: Raw API Request/Response Logs
panels.description: Complete logs from all API calls including payloads (truncated for readability). Errors and warnings are highlighted; limited to the most recent 500 lines.

panels.title: Monitoring & Alerts Summary
panels.description: Active alerts and anomalies detected across AWCS <-> McLeod integrations. Alert rules are provisioned separately (see awcs_mcleod_alert_rules.yaml) using Grafana unified alerting.

panels.title: Active Alert Count
panels.description: Number of AWCS/McLeod integration alerts currently firing. Requires a Prometheus/Mimir datasource receiving Grafana's alerting metrics — see note in README.

panels.title: Active Alerts & Anomalies
panels.description: Summary of alerts triggered in the last 24 hours: High Latency, Error Rate, Service Down, and Quota Exceeded. Filtered to alerts tagged integration/mcleod/awcs/sit.

list.name: api_endpoint
list.label: API Endpoint
list.description: Populated from extracted endpoint paths seen in the last 6h of matching logs.

query.query: label_values({service_name=~"$service_name", epe_service_env="sit"} |= "Outgoing HTTP Request ->" | regexp `Outgoing HTTP Request -> (?P<http_method>[A-Z]+) https?://[^/\s]+(?P<api_endpoint>/[^\s?]*)`, api_endpoint)

list.name: include_actuator
list.label: Include actuator endpoints
list.description: OFF (default) excludes /actuator/* noise; ON removes the exclusion filter.
